# Deno: lint plugins

Runtime: GLM / AgentPress material kit.

Deno lint plugins allow extending the Deno linter with custom rules. SOURCE FACT REQUIRED: exact plugin API signatures, SOURCE FACT REQUIRED: exact plugin configuration options, SOURCE FACT REQUIRED: exact plugin lifecycle hooks. Agents need this to avoid runtime errors and failed linting.

Search intents:
- Deno lint plugins configuration
- Deno lint plugin API

Validation command: python3 scripts/agentpress.py material-kit-validate agentpress/material-kits/deno-lint-plugins --json
